_meta.purpose: Delivery grammar for a dialog: one Dialog node on a screen-sized module frame. The component supplies the Backdrop.

dialog.note: Exactly one Dialog. Pick confirm for an irreversible action, acknowledge when there is nothing to decide, input for a one or two field task.

frame.note: The dialog is delivered as a screen-sized module frame so the Backdrop reads as an overlay over a viewport. No Header shell, no page sections.

rules: A modal is the Dialog component. It ships its own Backdrop and its Popover carries the header, body and footer slots — never rebuild it from a frame, an absolute Backdrop and a centered Card.
A region without content is switched off via the Popover's Show Start/End Slot booleans, never rendered empty.
The primary button names the action it performs. Avoid a bare OK when a verb is possible.
Exactly one Brand action per dialog. The secondary action is ghost, and it is omitted entirely when there is nothing to cancel.
Keep it to one short interaction. A longer task belongs on a form or process page, not in a dialog.
The dimmed backdrop is rendered as a static state. Open and close behaviour is out of scope — no prototyping.
Spacing between header, body and footer comes from the Popover's Spacing variant, not from an extra wrapper container.
